config.source:
SELECT
  cost_date,
  subscriptionname,
  resourcegroupname,
  metername,
  productname,
  api_access,
  COALESCE(spoke, 'Unassigned') AS spoke,
  COALESCE(application, 'Untagged') AS application,
  COALESCE(service, 'Unknown') AS service,
  COALESCE(model, 'Not specified') AS model,
  COALESCE(ai_capability, CASE WHEN api_access = 'Non-AI or unclassified' THEN 'Non-AI' ELSE 'Other AI' END) AS ai_capability,
  CASE
    WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(environment, '')) IN ('P', 'PRD', 'PROD', 'PRODUCTION') THEN 'Prod'
    WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(environment, '')) IN ('D', 'DEV', 'DEVELOPMENT') THEN 'Dev'
    WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(environment, '')) IN ('T', 'TST', 'TEST', 'QA', 'UAT', 'ACC', 'ACCEPTANCE') THEN 'Test'
    WHEN environment IS NULL OR TRIM(environment) = '' THEN 'Unknown'
    ELSE environment
  END AS environment,
  (api_access <> 'Non-AI or unclassified') AS is_ai,
  application_inferred,
  spoke_inferred,
  model_inferred,
  cost_eur,
  cost_usd,
  quantity
FROM automation_s.pierre.ai_foundry_costs_enriched
WHERE api_access <> 'Non-AI or unclassified'

dimensions.name: model_group
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN UPPER(model) LIKE '%GPT-4O%' OR UPPER(model) LIKE '%GPT-40%' OR UPPER(model) LIKE '%GPT-4-O%' OR model = 'cog-genai-openai-4o' THEN 'GPT-4o family'
  WHEN UPPER(model) LIKE '%GPT-4.1%' OR UPPER(model) LIKE '%GPT-4-1%' THEN 'GPT-4.1 family'
  WHEN UPPER(model) LIKE '%GPT-5%' THEN 'GPT-5 family'
  WHEN UPPER(model) LIKE '%GPT-3%' THEN 'GPT-3.5'
  WHEN UPPER(model) LIKE '%GPT-IMAGE%' OR UPPER(model) LIKE '%SORA%' THEN 'GPT Image / Video'
  WHEN UPPER(model) LIKE '%O1%' OR UPPER(model) LIKE '%O3%' THEN 'o-series (o1/o3)'
  WHEN UPPER(model) LIKE '%EMBEDDING%' THEN 'Embeddings'
  WHEN model LIKE 'cog-genai%' THEN 'Cognitive Services'
  WHEN UPPER(model) LIKE '%MISTRAL%' THEN 'Mistral'
  WHEN UPPER(model) LIKE '%CLAUDE%' OR UPPER(model) LIKE '%ANTHROPIC%' THEN 'Claude / Anthropic'
  WHEN model LIKE 'Premium%DBU' THEN 'Databricks Inference'
  WHEN model = 'GitHub Copilot' THEN 'GitHub Copilot'
  WHEN UPPER(model) LIKE '%COPILOT%' THEN 'Copilot Studio'
  WHEN model = 'Not specified' THEN 'Not specified'
  ELSE 'Other'
END

dimensions.name: rg_group
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN UPPER(resourcegroupname) LIKE '%ETEXMATE%' THEN 'Etex Mate'
  WHEN UPPER(resourcegroupname) LIKE '%MDP-COGNITIVE%' THEN 'MDP Cognitive'
  WHEN UPPER(resourcegroupname) LIKE '%MDP-DBW%' THEN 'MDP Databricks'
  WHEN UPPER(resourcegroupname) LIKE '%COPILOT%' THEN 'Copilot'
  WHEN UPPER(resourcegroupname) LIKE '%COGNIZANT%' OR UPPER(resourcegroupname) LIKE '%VOICEAI%' THEN 'Cognizant / DMZ'
  WHEN UPPER(resourcegroupname) LIKE '%UIPATH%' THEN 'UiPath'
  WHEN UPPER(resourcegroupname) LIKE '%DIGITAL%' THEN 'Digital'
  WHEN UPPER(resourcegroupname) LIKE '%PLAYGROUND%' OR UPPER(resourcegroupname) LIKE '%SANDBOX%' THEN 'Sandbox / Test'
  WHEN UPPER(resourcegroupname) LIKE '%GAMAI%' THEN 'GAM AI Assistant'
  WHEN resourcegroupname = '' OR resourcegroupname IS NULL THEN 'GitHub Copilot (SaaS)'
  ELSE 'Other'
END

dimensions.name: cap_group
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN ai_capability IN ('Azure OpenAI') THEN 'Azure OpenAI'
  WHEN ai_capability IN ('Claude / Anthropic') THEN 'Claude / Anthropic'
  WHEN ai_capability IN ('GitHub Copilot') THEN 'GitHub Copilot'
  WHEN ai_capability IN ('Azure Translator') THEN 'Azure Translator'
  WHEN ai_capability IN ('Copilot Studio') THEN 'Copilot Studio'
  WHEN ai_capability IN ('Defender for AI Services') THEN 'Defender for AI'
  WHEN ai_capability IN ('Azure Document Intelligence') THEN 'Document Intelligence'
  WHEN ai_capability IN ('Azure Speech', 'Azure Custom Vision', 'Azure Vision') THEN 'Vision & Speech'
  ELSE 'Other Cognitive'
END

dimensions.name: app_group
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN application = 'Etex Mate' THEN 'Etex Mate'
  WHEN application LIKE 'MDP%' THEN 'MDP Platform'
  WHEN application IN ('GenAI', 'GenAI-ChatBot', 'Cognizant GenAI Bot') THEN 'GenAI Apps'
  WHEN application = 'GitHub Copilot' THEN 'GitHub Copilot'
  WHEN application = 'Copilot Studio' THEN 'Copilot Studio'
  WHEN application = 'UiPath' THEN 'UiPath'
  WHEN application = 'VAP' THEN 'VAP'
  WHEN application IN ('SB', 'Sandbox', 'Azure OpenAI', 'Citadel') THEN 'Sandbox / Test'
  WHEN application = 'Untagged' THEN 'Untagged'
  ELSE 'Other Apps'
END

measures.name: ai_cost_eur
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_ai THEN cost_eur ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: ai_cost_usd
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_ai THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: ai_share
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_ai THEN cost_eur ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(cost_eur), 0)
measures.comment: AI cost as share of total cost

measures.name: active_applications
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN application <> 'Untagged' THEN application END)

measures.name: untagged_app_cost_eur
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN application = 'Untagged' THEN cost_eur ELSE 0 END)
measures.comment: Cost without any application tag or inference

measures.name: inferred_app_cost_eur
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN application_inferred THEN cost_eur ELSE 0 END)
measures.comment: Cost whose application was inferred from RG naming

measures.name: app_tag_coverage
measures.expr: 1 - SUM(CASE WHEN application = 'Untagged' THEN cost_eur ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(cost_eur), 0)
measures.comment: Share of cost with an application (tagged or inferred)

measures.name: spoke_coverage
measures.expr: 1 - SUM(CASE WHEN spoke = 'Unassigned' THEN cost_eur ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(cost_eur), 0)
measures.comment: Share of cost assigned to a spoke

measures.name: model_coverage_ai
measures.expr: 1 - SUM(CASE WHEN is_ai AND model = 'Not specified' THEN cost_eur ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_ai THEN cost_eur ELSE 0 END), 0)
measures.comment: Share of AI cost with an identified model/deployment

lines:
## Etex AI Cost Overview
All figures below reflect **AI-classified cost only** (`is_ai = TRUE`). Non-AI Azure consumption is excluded.

**AI inclusion rule:** `api_access` IN ('AI Foundry / Azure AI', 'Copilot', 'Other model access')

## Hub-and-Spoke AI Architecture

The Etex enterprise hub connects to domain spokes, each hosting AI workloads. Cost is allocated by the `spoke` field in the enriched table.

| Spoke | AI Applications | Primary AI Capabilities | Est. Share |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Intelligent Automation** | Etex Mate, GenAI-ChatBot, Copilot Studio, UiPath, VoiceAI, GAM AI Assistant | Azure OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, Copilot Studio, Azure Speech | ~82% |
| **Modern Data Platform** | MDP Cognitive Services, MDP Domain use cases, AI for CAC ML | Azure Translator, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI | ~13% |
| **Shared Services** | GitHub Copilot (enterprise-wide) | GitHub Copilot | ~2% |
| **DMZ** | Askiva Translator, Cognizant GenAI Bot | Azure Translator | ~1% |
| **Digital** | VAP, AI Search | Azure Custom Vision, Azure Speech | <1% |
| **Foundations** | Sandbox, GenAI | Azure OpenAI | <1% |
| **Cross Domain** | Low Code Copilot | Azure OpenAI | <1% |

**Hub** (Shared Services) provides centralised identity, networking, and the GitHub Copilot enterprise licence. Each spoke owns its own Azure AI Foundry resources and Databricks model-serving endpoints.

## Application → API → Backend

Each application reaches its AI backend through one of three independent access routes (field: `api_access`). Routes are **not chained**.

### Route 1 — AI Foundry / Azure AI
| Application | AI Capability | Key Models |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Etex Mate | Azure OpenAI | gpt-4.1-etexmate, gpt-5-etexmate, gpt-image-1 |
| Etex Mate | Claude / Anthropic | anthropic-claude-sonnet-4 |
| GenAI-ChatBot | Azure OpenAI | gpt-4o, gpt-4.1, o3-mini |
| MDP Cognitive | Azure Translator, Doc Intelligence | Azure Cognitive Services |
| MDP Domain | Azure OpenAI | gpt-4o, text-embedding-3-large |
| Askiva Translator | Azure Translator | Azure Translator |
| VAP | Custom Vision, Speech | Azure CV + Speech |

### Route 2 — Copilot (SaaS)
| Application | AI Capability | Backend |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GitHub Copilot | GitHub Copilot | GitHub SaaS |
| Copilot Studio | Copilot Studio | Microsoft 365 SaaS |

### Route 3 — Other model access
| Application | AI Capability | Backend |
| --- | --- | --- |
| UiPath | Claude / Anthropic | Databricks Serverless Inference |
